For your students

Everything your players get, included.

One login opens the full Chess Nexus experience — the tools that actually make players stronger.

★ 100% free to start✓ No ads, ever✓ For beginners to advanced

Puzzle Dashboard

Tracks every theme a player solves and surfaces their strong and weak tactics — so training targets exactly what needs work.

Nexus Guide

Scans a player's games to pinpoint recurring weaknesses and tells them what to practise next — a personal coach in the background.

Deep Analysis

Server-side Stockfish 18 reviews every game and returns clear, plain-language insights — blunders, turning points and better plans.

Studies

A library of endgame studies, master games and Nexus's own curated studies — structured lessons players can work through anytime.

3D Arena

An immersive 3D board that makes online play feel real — perfect for keeping younger players engaged and having fun.

Social Club

Clubs, friends and chat in a safe, moderated space — students compete, discuss games and belong to a community.

Free forever

Everything above is free forever for up to 30 students.

Not a 30-day trial. Not a card on file. If you coach 30 students or fewer, you can run your entire coaching on Chess Nexus without ever paying us — and that includes the live classroom.

  • ✓Up to 30 students
  • ✓Unlimited batches
  • ✓All 7 assignment types
  • ✓30 courses, 3 lessons each
  • ✓Class schedule & attendance
  • ✓Parent progress reports
  • ✓Fee & payment tracking
  • ✓Coach ↔ student chat
  • ✓The live classroom
  • ✓Premium tools for 90 days

Growing past 30 students? Paid plans raise the cap and unlock unlimited live classes with bigger rooms. Go over later and nothing is deleted — you simply move back to the free limits, with every student, course and record intact.

Included on every plan, free ones too

What's inside the live classroom.

Most online chess lessons are a video call in one window and a chess site in another. Here the video and the board are the same room — so there is no "can you see my screen?", and no second app to pay for.

📹

HD video & screen share

See the whole class. Noise suppression and video touch-up are built in.

♟️

One shared board

Move a piece and it moves on every student's screen instantly.

🖱️

Give a student control

Hand over the board so they play the move in front of the class, then take it back.

✏️

Draw on the board

Arrows and highlights sync to everyone — point at the plan instead of describing it.

📚

Load anything instantly

Your studies, courses, library, endgames, puzzles by theme and master games.

🤖

Private engine

Stockfish for your eyes only. Students see just the board.

📌

One-click homework

Capture the position as you teach, send the whole set as one assignment.

📋

Attendance writes itself

Admitting a student records their attendance. No register to fill in after.

⏳

Waiting room

Nobody wanders in halfway through an explanation.

✋

Raise hand

Their tile jumps to the front of your grid.

🎙️

Mic & camera control

Mute in one click. Turning it back on is always a request the child accepts.

♟️

Play in class

The whole class plays at once with live clocks. Spotlight any board for everyone.

🎲

Simul

Play every student at once, swapping between boards like a Lichess simul.

🏁

Private races

Launch an Arena race for your class — only your own students can join.

Everything a coach gets

The whole coaching workspace.

The roster, the homework, the syllabus, the timetable, the attendance register, the fees and the report you send the parent — one login, one place.

👥

Students, batches & fees

  • Students request to join, or you invite them
  • Group them into batches by level, age or class
  • See who is online right now, before class starts
  • Private per-student notes only you can see
  • Track enrollment, fees and payments in the same place
Coaching platform →
📝

Assignments — 7 types

  • Puzzle topics, whole studies or a single chapter
  • Timed Puzzle Rush and arena tournaments
  • Play-vs-Stockfish positions from a visual board editor — never type a FEN
  • Find-the-Blunder pulled from a student's own games
  • Save your best as templates, or pull the admin blunder library
  • Solve rate and accuracy recorded per student, automatically
How assignments work →
📚

Course builder — 5 lesson types

  • Your own studies, or a single chapter of one
  • Built-in Nexus studies, so you don't author every lesson
  • Video lessons in between the board work
  • Master games, searchable by player or opening
  • Endgame positions
  • Enrol a whole batch — it appears in their My Syllabus, in order
Course builder →
📅

Schedule & attendance

  • Weekly class slots per batch — days, time, duration
  • You set it in your timezone; every student sees it in theirs
  • Change it and students are notified automatically — nobody chases anyone
  • Present, Absent and Catch-up, so records match what happened
  • Export any period as CSV

Parent progress reports

  • One shareable link per student — the parent needs no account
  • Rating over time, puzzles solved, accuracy
  • What you assigned, what they finished, how they scored
  • Attendance, including catch-up classes
  • Recent games — including their Lichess and Chess.com games

Private activities & chat

  • Arena races and tournaments only your students can join

  • Elite coaches get unlimited Team Race and Monthly Focus events

For academies & institutions

More than one coach? Run the whole academy.

An academy sits on top of normal coach accounts. Invite your coaches by email or a join link, pay for all of them on one central bill, and oversee every coach, student and live class from a single dashboard — while still teaching your own students from the same login. No coach ever enters a card.

  • Plans for 5, 10 or 25 coaches — up to 3,750 students
  • Bulk discounts up to 20%, plus 10% for paying 3 months up front
  • The head coach is still a coach, not locked into admin
  • If a plan lapses, nobody is locked out and no data is lost
